title: disco: a toolkit for Distributional Control of Generative Models
measurement_description: The paper mentions, as an example application of its toolkit, the ability to balance the 'regard' score among different religious groups. This is cited from another paper (Go et al., 2023) and not a new experiment conducted within this paper.
findings: The paper does not present original findings on religion but states that its Distributional Control (GDC) technique can be used to address bias in language models, citing as an example the work of Go et al. (2023) which used the technique to balance the 'regard' score among different religious groups.
